skill.name: cold-email-deliverability
skill.description: Guides a 15-point email deliverability review covering authentication, domain reputation, mailbox warm-up, TLS, and message signing. Produces a checklist score and prioritized fixes.
skill.summary: Review sending-domain readiness with DNS lookups, public reputation checks, and a prioritized remediation report.
skill.author: cmj-hub

security_audit.summary: All 28 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate diagnostic lookups, public reference links, or a documentation path. No evidence found of credential theft, destructive actions, or prompt injection. One semantic issue remains: score-based launch advice can conflict with mandatory authentication and blacklist blockers.

remediation.issue: Score-based launch advice can permit sending despite authentication failures or blacklist hits.
remediation.suggestion: Make blocker failures override every grade and readiness label. Mark unavailable checks as unverified and require verification before approving launch.

semantic_findings.title: Readiness Grades Can Override Authentication Blockers
semantic_findings.description: The workflow calls authentication failures and blacklist hits blockers, but the grade table says "Ship but fix the B-list within 30 days". Passing 14 of 15 checks scores 93.3, allowing launch advice despite one unresolved blocker and risking unauthenticated sending or reputation damage.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The unweighted score and permissive B-grade advice directly conflict with the earlier blocker rule. The risk is contradictory guidance, not demonstrated automated sending.

content.value_statement: Authentication gaps and domain reputation problems can disrupt outreach before a campaign starts. This skill guides 15 readiness checks and organizes failures into prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Guides SPF presence, provider coverage, and recursive DNS lookup-count checks.
Reviews DKIM selector resolution, key length, DMARC policy, and aggregate reporting configuration.
Uses public blacklist lookups and reverse-DNS checks to assess sending-domain reputation.
Compares mailbox age, daily sending volume, and recent reply ratio against documented thresholds.
Includes MX STARTTLS and message-body signing checks, with manual fallbacks when tools are unavailable.
Calculates a 0-100 checklist score and prioritizes authentication failures, blacklist hits, and other fixes.
limitations: Requires DNS utilities, public lookup access, and user-supplied sending details; unavailable tools require manual verification.
Does not change DNS records, warm mailboxes, or send campaign messages.
The score is a checklist result, not an inbox-placement guarantee; launch advice can conflict with blocker failures.
The workflow does not define BIMI, Postmaster, SNDS, or spam-content lint checks despite broader source-description claims.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check deliverability for [sending_domain]. Ask for missing sending details and explain which checks require manual verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect the information needed for a first review.

prompt_templates.title: Review Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Review SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for [sending_domain] using provider [inbox_provider] and selector [selector]. Report observed evidence and prioritize authentication failures.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Mailbox Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [sending_domain] for [from_address]. Provider: [provider]; mailbox age: [days]; daily volume: [volume]; reply ratio: [percent]. Include reputation and warm-up checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assess campaign timing using mailbox details.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Launch Blockers
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the 15-point review for [sending_domain] using [sending_details]. Show evidence, unavailable checks, score, and fix order. Keep launch blocked until blocker checks pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile checklist scores with mandatory launch blockers.

output_examples.input: Fourteen checks passed, but SPF does not include our sending provider. Summarize readiness and the next action.
output: Launch status: hold. The SPF failure remains a blocker despite the numerical grade.
First action: correct provider authorization in SPF, check the DNS lookup limit, and verify authentication before sending.

output_examples.input: Ten checks passed. Mailbox age, sending volume, reply ratio, reverse DNS, and blacklist checks failed. Prioritize the fixes.
output: Checklist score: 66.7/100, grade D. Hold the campaign.
Resolve the blacklist issue first and verify reverse DNS with the sending provider.
Reduce sending volume, continue mailbox preparation, and review reply performance before reassessing.

best_practices: Provide the sending domain, provider, DKIM selector, sending IP, mailbox age, volume, and recent reply ratio when available.
Record observed evidence and keep unavailable checks unverified instead of treating them as passes.
Resolve authentication failures and blacklist hits before sending, regardless of the numerical score.
anti_patterns: Treating a high checklist score as proof of inbox placement or permission to ignore blockers.
Providing API keys or mailbox credentials when public lookups and nonsecret sending details are sufficient.
Applying DNS changes or increasing sending volume without verifying findings and current provider requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It guides 15 checks covering SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blacklists, reverse DNS, mailbox readiness, MX TLS, and message signing.

faq.question: Does it require paid tools or API keys?
faq.answer: No. The workflow prohibits paid API calls and API-key requests, and provides manual fallbacks when tools are unavailable.

faq.question: Does it send emails or update DNS?
faq.answer: The documented workflow performs diagnostic reviews and recommends fixes. It does not implement campaign sending or DNS changes.

faq.question: What does the score mean?
faq.answer: It is the percentage of 15 checks that pass. Authentication failures and blacklist hits should block launch regardless of the grade.

faq.question: Can it guarantee delivery to the inbox?
faq.answer: No. Checklist results do not guarantee inbox placement, and provider policies should be verified against current requirements.

faq.question: Can I use it without the parent cold-email skill?
faq.answer: The source marks it as a helper loaded by cold-email, not a directly invocable skill. Standalone tool availability and referenced documentation require verification.
